name: Case 5 escalated to critical with impact reason and updated description
description: Case 5 escalated to critical with impact reason and updated description

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case
WHERE case_id = 5
  AND priority = 'critical'
  AND escalation = 1
  AND escalation_reason = 'impact'
  AND short_description = 'Product: Palo Alto Networks PA-3220, Issue: Major packet drops affecting production - significantly worsened';

name: Knowledge 227 linked to case 5 as suggested
description: Knowledge 227 linked to case 5 as suggested

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM case_knowledge
WHERE case_id = 5
  AND knowledge_id = 227
  AND used_as = 'suggested';

name: Critical response SLA linked to case 5
description: Critical response SLA linked to case 5

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM case_sla
WHERE case_id = 5
  AND sla_def_id = 1
  AND stage = 'in_progress';

name: Notification with KB article sent to Elizabeth
description: Notification with KB article sent to Elizabeth

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM notification
WHERE case_id = 5
  AND email = 'elizabeth.chase32@servicenow.com'
  AND type = 'update'
  AND knowledge_id = 227
  AND status = 'success';

name: Critical resolution SLA linked to case 5
